paper_title: More Tokens, Lower Precision Towards the Optimal Token-Precision   Trade-off in KV Cache Compression
caption: The results of layer-wise quantized pruning on Llama-3-8B-Instruct, with SnapKV as pruning method. We use 4 KV token 4-bit as baseline and report the relative change. Configurations are modified every 4 layers for the initial and final layers, while intermediate layers are reconfigured every 8 layers.
model_annotation: The plot illustrates the layer-wise relative change in performance for different quantization and token configuration settings in the KV cache compression of Llama-3-8B-Instruct, using SnapKV as the pruning method. The x-axis represents five grouped layers: Layer1-4, Layer5-12, Layer13-20, Layer21-28, and Layer29-32, with a categorical scale and no numerical units. The y-axis shows the relative change in percentage, ranging from -15% to 5%, with a linear scale and tick marks at intervals of 5%. A dashed gray line at 0% marks the baseline performance, corresponding to a 4×tokens, 4-bit configuration. Four lines are plotted: a yellow line with circular markers for "LB-Avg of 2×tokens,8-bit", which starts near 0%, dips slightly to about -1% at Layer5-12, rises to approximately 1% at Layer13-20, and ends near 2% at Layer29-32; a red line with square markers for "LB-Avg of 1×tokens,16-bit", which begins near 0%, decreases to about -2% at Layer5-12, remains stable around -2% through Layer13-20 and Layer21-28, and ends near -1% at Layer29-32; a light blue line with circular markers for "RULER4k of 2×tokens,8-bit", which starts near 0%, drops to about -3% at Layer5-12, further declines to approximately -6% at Layer13-20, rises to around -4% at Layer21-28, and ends near -2% at Layer29-32; and a dark blue line with square markers for "RULER4k of 1×tokens,16-bit", which begins near 0%, decreases to about -6% at Layer5-12, drops further to approximately -15% at Layer13-20, recovers to around -10% at Layer21-28, and ends near -2% at Layer29-32. All lines are connected with solid segments, and the data points are marked with their respective symbols.
